purpose: Wave-4 critical combat/elite skill training gap fill for Attack, Strength, Defence, Magic, Ranged, Necromancy, Invention, and Dungeoneering — wiki-published XP rates only; ironman/Equilibrium region notes; no invented Divination rates.

methods.method: Early melee ladder (cows, goblins, rock crabs, armoured zombies)
methods.level_range: 1-50 Attack (Constitution scales with kills)
methods.location: Lumbridge cows / Goblin Village / Fremennik rock crabs / Armoured zombies (Temple Trekking / Lair of Tarn Razorlor)
methods.xp_rate: wiki combat tables marked incomplete post-2023 combat XP changes; early bands are low tens of thousands XP/h, scaling with gear and AoE — do not treat legacy pre-2023 tables as absolute
methods.notes: Ironman: self-sourced bronze→rune/necronium ladder. Prefer multi-combat packs once Hurricane/Flurry unlock. Combat XP is 50 XP per 1,000 life points damaged (wiki general rule). Assign XP to Attack only in combat settings if pure Attack needed.
methods.warning: Pay-to-play melee training page is incomplete after 2023 combat XP changes.

methods.method: Abyss AFK multi-style combat (Attack XP assignment)
methods.level_range: 70+ recommended gear; high-end ~T90
methods.location: Abyss (Wilderness entrance), south-west / south-east corners
methods.xp_rate: wiki publishes over 500,000+ combat XP/h on a measured melee halberd setup (power armour, blood amulet, super melee potion; dragon rider lance recommended); overall guide notes 50,000-2,000,000 XP/h depending on level and gear
methods.notes: Hard Forinthry/Wilderness Abyss gate. Assign combat XP to Attack (or Attack+Strength). Ironman: aggression potions optional; Soul Split / vampyrism for sustain. Wiki frames Abyss as among the best AFK combat XP methods.
methods.warning: Melee training page still carries incomplete/outdated XP table banner after 2023 combat XP changes; treat 500k+ as wiki-published setup measurement, not guaranteed ironman floor.

methods.level_range: 75+ Attack for Sunspear; 78 for reforged Sunspear preferred
methods.location: Darkmeyer upper tier (tree spot south-southwest of bank)
methods.xp_rate: wiki Pay-to-play melee training: maximum combat XP/h around 490,000-655,000; plus 160,000-215,000 Constitution XP/h; Prayer 315,000-415,000 with Morytania legs 4
methods.notes: Requires Lord of Vampyrium / River of Blood path for Sunspear. Ironman multi-skill: combat + Prayer (corpses) + seedicide. Melee preferred for AoE. Strategies page may lag Combat Style Modernisation (March 2026) ability bars.

methods.level_range: combat 40+ recommended entry; scales to high worlds
methods.location: Void Knights' Outpost Shattered Worlds portal (Asgarnia sea / Port Sarim boat)
methods.xp_rate: not a single fixed XP/h on the SW page; combat XP scales with world tier and kill speed. Invention training page recommends SW for very rapid equipment item XP (pair with Attack training)
methods.notes: Safe deaths. Augmented gear still gains item XP. Ironman: free equip-me/feed-me scaled gear for early combat levels. Prefer Feeling Pumped mutator. Region: Void Knights' Outpost is Asgarnia-locked for League planners.

methods.level_range: 70-120 combat with slayer helmet progression
methods.location: Task-dependent (masters: Raptor Fort Forinthry, Sumona Desert, Duradel Karamja, Laniakea Anachronia, Mandrith Wilderness)
methods.xp_rate: not normalized pure Attack XP/h; wiki notes Slayer helmet 7.5%-9.5% damage and 12.5%-14.5% accuracy on-task partially offsets wrong-style weaknesses; high-end multi tasks compete with dedicated AFK camps
methods.notes: Ironman primary combat path. Helmet components region-gated (black mask / focus sight / hexcrest / spectral lens). Assign XP to Attack when accuracy weapons are the bottleneck.

methods.level_range: 70+; T90 gear for wiki-measured ceiling
methods.location: Abyss south-west / south-east aggressive corners
methods.xp_rate: wiki measured melee Abyss setup over 500,000+ XP/h; same camp as Attack — assign combat XP to Strength (or Strength+Attack)
methods.notes: Strength potions / extreme strength increase damage and thus XP/h per wiki general notes. Ironman: Forinthry unlock mandatory for Abyss entrance.
methods.warning: Do not use pre-2023 combat XP table rows as optimizer truth.

methods.level_range: 75+ with Sunspear melee; high Strength for damage
methods.location: Darkmeyer six-vyre tree spot
methods.xp_rate: combat XP band 490,000-655,000/h on the melee training page when using optimal vyre multi; Strength share depends on combat XP settings
methods.notes: Wiki states melee is best style at vyres for Soul Split AoE. Ironman value: blisterwood/Sunspear path is Morytania-hard. Pair with seedicide and prayer corpse burning.

methods.level_range: any with halberd tier; 82+ Laniakea's spear / 90+ noxious scythe for high rates
methods.location: Any dense multi-combat pack (Abyss, Sophanem corrupted, abyssal creatures, Slayer multi tasks)
methods.xp_rate: scales with target HP density; wiki general: ~500,000 XP/h expected with tier 90 gear on good multi camps; Abyss measured setup exceeds 500,000+
methods.notes: Wiki weapon table recommends bronze→rune→dragon→crystal→Laniakea→noxious→Tumeken's Light ladder. Halberds expand AoE to 5x5. Ironman: dragon halberd needs Regicide (Tirannwn); crystal needs Roving Elves + 50 Agility.

methods.level_range: 85+ Slayer for abyssal demons; higher for beasts/lords
methods.location: Abyssal Area / Senntisten Asylum (beasts); standard abyssal demon locations
methods.xp_rate: not a single published XP/h on the method row; wiki lists abyssal beasts at 39,000 LP / 1,950 combat XP per kill example and recommends them for kinetic cyclone profit+XP loops
methods.notes: Ironman charm and ash/loot value. Kinetic cyclone (70 Invention) cited as optional AFK damage add-on (~2,000 cannonballs/h).

methods.method: Combat XP assigned to Defence (any style)
methods.location: Same camps as style training; toggle Skills & Experience combat XP to Defence or Defence+style
methods.xp_rate: matches underlying camp damage rates (e.g. Abyss wiki measurement 500,000+ when using that setup; vyres 490,000-655,000 combat band) — Defence receives the assigned share
methods.notes: Wiki states Defence can be trained with melee, Magic, or Ranged by combat XP settings. Ironman: tank armour ladder for survivability; power armour still preferred when XP rate matters more than mitigation.

methods.method: Vyrewatch Darkmeyer with Defence XP share
methods.level_range: 80+ Defence for T80 power armour recommendations on strategies page
methods.location: Darkmeyer
methods.xp_rate: combat XP 490,000-655,000/h band; assign portion or full to Defence via combat settings
methods.notes: Strategies page suggests 80 Defence for T80+ power armour. Ironman Morytania legs 4 boosts Prayer XP at the same camp (315k-415k Prayer with legs 4 at six-vyre spot per strategies/melee pages).

methods.method: Magic combat with Defence XP (ganodermic / subjugation band)
methods.level_range: 70-99 Magic and Defence gear tiers
methods.location: Standard Magic training monsters (wiki Magic training ladder 70-99 sections)
methods.xp_rate: combat XP tables on Magic training page marked incomplete post-2023; non-combat alch rates are separate (see Magic methods). Use camp damage rates, not legacy tables
methods.notes: Useful when ironman needs Defence without melee. Corruption Blast recommended (+28% exp/hour per Abyss Magic measurement notes).
methods.warning: Pay-to-play Magic training incomplete after 2023 combat XP changes.

methods.location: Abyss aggressive corners
methods.xp_rate: same Abyss measurements as style guides: melee setup 500,000+ XP/h; Magic Abyss AFK measurement 549,601.0 XP/h; Ranged red chin Abyss measurement 702,054.8 XP/h — assign to Defence as needed
methods.notes: Wiki Ranged/Magic pages call Abyss among the best AFK XP/hour methods. Ironman Forinthry gate.

methods.level_range: 55-99 (common ironman AFK path)
methods.location: Bank standing anywhere; portable well optional
methods.xp_rate: wiki: typically 65,000-78,000 Magic XP/h at ~1,200 alchs/hour
methods.intensity: very low AFK / click every alch
methods.notes: Ironman: nature runes from RC or shops; alchables from combat/skilling. Not peak XP but supply-friendly. Low Level Alchemy wiki max ~62,000 XP/h from level 21 until ~40.

methods.location: Bank or ore box + furnace/portable forge routing
methods.xp_rate: wiki: 55.5 Magic XP per cast → maximum 111,000 Magic XP/h at 1.8s cast speed
methods.notes: Pairs with Smithing bars for ironmen. Nature + fire runes (or staff of fire).

methods.level_range: 86 Magic; Dream Mentor completed
methods.location: Lunar spellbook bank standing with logs
methods.xp_rate: wiki: about 150,000 Magic XP/h if concentrated
methods.notes: Hard Lunar Diplomacy + Dream Mentor (Fremennik/Lunar Isle). Ironman Construction log sink synergy. Requires astral runes.

methods.level_range: high Magic with Archaeology soil bank; archaeologist outfit noted
methods.location: Any bank with soil loads; Archaeology sites for supply
methods.xp_rate: wiki: potentially over 500,000 Magic XP/h (1-tick casts with archaeologist's outfit); also low-intensity screening up to 100 soil per action
methods.intensity: active tick-perfect peak or low-intensity bulk
methods.notes: Ironman: soil from Archaeology digs — not a pure Magic unlock. Peak rates assume outfit and tick methods.

methods.method: Abyss AFK Magic (Air Surge / Blood Barrage)
methods.level_range: 80+ weapons recommended for wiki AFK measurement
methods.location: Abyss south-west / south-east corners
methods.xp_rate: wiki published measurement 549,601.0 Magic XP/h AFK (Air Surge or Blood Barrage; Armadyl battlestaff recommended). Corruption Blast increases exp/hour by 28% on the guide notes
methods.notes: Wiki calls Abyss Magic/Ranged among best AFK exp/hour. Ironman: rune supply + Forinthry. Blood Barrage needs Ancient Magicks (Desert Treasure).
methods.warning: Magic combat XP tables still incomplete post-2023; this figure is a specific wiki setup measurement.

methods.level_range: 45+ chinchompas; high Ranged + power armour for measurement
methods.location: Abyss multi corners
methods.xp_rate: wiki published measurement 702,054.8 Ranged XP/h AFK (red chinchompa, power armour, blood amulet, grand ranging potion, Armadyl/off-hand crossbow notes). Corruption Shot critical — +28% XP/h
methods.notes: Ironman chin supply is Hunter-gated (grey/red/mechanised). Mechanised chinchompas (Invention) for non-augment mainhand AoE. Expensive vs waterfiends for ironmen.
methods.warning: Ranged training page incomplete after 2023 combat XP changes.

methods.level_range: high mid-game; 92 Prayer Soul Split; 96 Herblore overloads recommended
methods.location: Ancient Cavern waterfiends / related waterfiend camps per guide
methods.xp_rate: wiki: with at least T70 armour and T80 weapons — 450,000 XP/h concentrating, 350,000 XP/h totally AFK; 100+ crimson charms/h
methods.notes: Cheaper AFK alternative to Abyss chins per wiki. Ironman charm engine for Summoning. Geyser titan helpful not required. Region: Ancient Cavern typically Forinthry/Kandarin cluster — treat as multi if League boundaries differ; guide pairs with Wilderness-style AFK alternatives.

methods.level_range: mid Ranged with decent weapons
methods.location: Taverley Dungeon black demons
methods.xp_rate: wiki: over 150 kills/h possible → around 150,000-400,000 experience per hour depending on gear/focus; also strong charm source
methods.notes: Ironman: Taverley is free Misthalin/Asgarnia access. Dwarf multicannon (Dwarf Cannon quest, Asgarnia) accelerates. Loot covers some costs on mains; ironmen value charms and alchables.

methods.level_range: 45+ grey; 55+ red; 70+ for serious multi; mechanised T75 Invention weapon
methods.location: Any dense multi (Abyss, Slayer multi, SW, caves)
methods.xp_rate: Abyss red chin wiki measurement 702,054.8 XP/h is the published peak AFK reference; other multis scale lower with density
methods.notes: Ironman: Hunter trap chin farming or alternative ammo. Mechanised chinchompas cannot be augmented but pair with augmented off-hand for Invention (wiki Invention training).

methods.level_range: any after Dwarf Cannon quest; scales with targets
methods.location: Cannon-legal multi areas (black demons, slayer tasks, etc.)
methods.xp_rate: not a standalone published XP/h; multiplies kill rate on multi-combat tasks — combine with camp rates (e.g. black demon 150k-400k band)
methods.notes: Quest-locked Asgarnia. Ironman smith cannonballs. Restricted in many areas — check location list on Ranged training page. Oldak coil is separate high-end option.

methods.location: Underworld portal by Draynor lodestone; City of Um ritual site
methods.xp_rate: wiki path: complete Necromancy! then ~50 lesser communion with fragile mementos → ~400 souls / ~level 26; Kili Row + Rune Mythos add 1,500 XP to reach ~27 — not a continuous XP/h figure
methods.notes: City of Um treated as Misthalin for League working taxonomy. Ironman: fragile mementos GE-bought on mains; ironmen source via content drops/shops. Unlocks Well of Souls talent tiers.

methods.location: Undead-focused camps (guide prefers undead for damage bonuses); City of Um adjacent content
methods.xp_rate: wiki Summary: combat is the primary 27-90 path; AFK-capable but slower than high-level rituals. No single frozen XP/h — scales with Death Skull / deathwarden tier every 10 levels
methods.notes: Ironman: complete Kili tasks each tier; craft death guard / skull lantern upgrades; ensoul materials via rituals. Deathwarden nexus at 60 holds necrotic runes. Prefer power Deathdealer from 70 when tasks allow.

methods.method: High-level rituals (powerful tier, high soul attraction)
methods.location: City of Um ritual site
methods.xp_rate: wiki Summary: rituals are the fastest 90-120 method (active). Maintain high soul attraction (ironman guide: at least 501% on powerful rituals). Disturbance schedule is deterministic; ~2.5% XP/h difference between 610% vs 700% attraction setups per cited player data on page
methods.notes: Ironman Mode/Guide/Necromancy: stock necroplasm/ink, Multiply III (boost to 103), communion to 35k souls, greater ensoul for cloths. Underworld Grimoire +3-12% disturbance XP. Ritualist outfit +1-6%. Ring of Kayazu +80% soul attraction (Havenhythe Arch).

methods.location: City of Um
methods.xp_rate: wiki ritual table lists base XP per powerful necroplasm ritual on the order of ~37,040 base XP before disturbance XP (majority of rate is disturbances at high attraction)
methods.notes: Attraction III glyphs for soul attraction. Ironman ink/necroplasm production is the supply gate. Do not invent hourly rates beyond wiki base + qualitative disturbance guidance.

methods.location: Slayer / undead camps / general PvM with T90 deathdealer or deathwarden
methods.xp_rate: wiki Summary: slower than rituals; positioned as the AFK alternative while rituals are fastest
methods.notes: Use when ink/focus supply is low. Still upgrade via Kili. Conduit+siphon dual wield only.

methods.level_range: 1-27 Invention (80 Crafting/Divination/Smithing to unlock)
methods.location: Invention Guild NE of Falador lodestone
methods.xp_rate: tutorial with perfect discovery → level 4; then 186,000 XP to 27 via augment two T70-75 items to equipment level 5 and disassemble. Cost-efficient example: two augmented black salamanders. Divine charge route: ~2 Invention XP per magic log disassembled; charges give 220 Invention XP craft — ~2-3 hours logs+energy for mid-20s
methods.intensity: burst setup + combat to level items
methods.notes: Ironman: Asgarnia guild access unless League auto-unlocks Invention tutorial (unresolved for Equilibrium — do not hard-require Asgarnia until confirmed). Black salamanders + harralander tar for cheap disassemble path.

methods.level_range: 27-120 (siphon unlock at 27 discovery)
methods.location: Any high combat XP camp (Abyss, SW 91-95 or 116-120 brackets recommended on wiki)
methods.xp_rate: wiki overview: combat highly varies but faster than skilling (<320,000 XP/h skilling ceiling). Cost/speed table: Siphon T90 at level 9 → 227,700 Invention XP per siphon cycle (item XP path); with XP Capacitor 5000 doubles item XP (fastest XP column). Level 12 siphon 621,000 Invention XP/cycle cheaper GP/XP
methods.intensity: combat AFK/active + siphon clicks (or mechanised siphon at 77)
methods.notes: Disassembly/siphon XP ignores most XP boosts (wiki). Augment body+legs+weapons; legs blueprint ~45 (boostable). Enlightened perk +3% item XP rate per rank. Ironman: siphons and capacitors are production/GE-restricted — craft siphons.

methods.method: Augmented crystal fishing rod / tool siphon (skilling)
methods.level_range: 22+ tool research; 99 Fishing for cited Frenzy rates
methods.location: Deep Sea Fishing Hub Fishing Frenzy; also Waterfall Fishing / tools elsewhere
methods.xp_rate: wiki: at 99 Fishing, at least 26,300 item experience per hour at Fishing Frenzy (higher with fishing/shark outfit + Enlightened/Wise). Item level 9 in just over 1 hour; level 12 in just over 3 hours. Skilling Invention overall <320,000 Invention XP/h
methods.notes: Crystal fishing rod is Tirannwn/Prif + crystal urchin points pipeline for ironmen. Lower charge drain than combat gear. Prefer siphon over disassemble on expensive crystal tools.

methods.level_range: 86+ (ancient gizmos / high Invention)
methods.location: Invention Guild workbench
methods.xp_rate: wiki: creating gizmos approximately 21,500,000 XP/h; timeworn ancient armour gizmos 21,500,000 XP/h stated. 86-120 needs 60,672,821 XP → ~2.83 hours and ~1,885 ancient gizmos at wiki cost assumptions (main-game GE)
methods.notes: Fastest non-combat Invention. Ironman: timeworn components are Archaeology/rare-gated — treat as theoretical ceiling, not default ironman path. Capacitors do not apply to gizmo XP.
methods.warning: GP/XP ~20.79 on wiki main-game prices; ironman component reality differs sharply.

methods.level_range: 1-120 (floors unlock with level)
methods.location: Daemonheim (Wilderness peninsula); official world 77
methods.xp_rate: page marked may be out of date after Dungeoneering Remastered; no single frozen XP/h for modern floors — strategy is complexity + size + party efficiency. Gorajan trailblazer full set ~+10.2% end-of-floor DG XP (5% skill × 5% base multiplicative); warped set ~+14.5%
methods.notes: Ironman token sink for chaotics/ring of vigour/charming imp. Party floors on w77. Relic Inspire Love +2% support XP. Perfect juju dungeoneering +5% damage and +2 invisible door levels.
methods.warning: Do not trust pre-Remastered XP/floor tables as current optimizer truth.

methods.level_range: mid-high combat; scales with ED1/ED2/ED3 access
methods.location: Temple of Aminishi / Dragonkin Laboratory / The Shadow Reef (and related ED content)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: with a team of three, upwards of 130,000 Dungeoneering XP/h killing only early mobs and mini-bosses (token/fragment focused)
methods.notes: Good ironman token + elite skilling outfit fragment route. Region locks depend which ED is available in League picks.

methods.level_range: matches each resource dungeon DG requirement
methods.location: Scattered resource dungeons across the map
methods.xp_rate: one-time large XP drops per dungeon unlock (no tokens at the normal 5 XP:1 token ratio for this XP); not continuous XP/h
methods.notes: Wiki early training tip: unlock resource dungeons as available for free DG levels and deeper floor access. Ironman: no GP gate — just level + keys where required.

methods.method: Sinkholes daily + Daemonheim Dig Site token boxes
methods.level_range: Sinkholes mid; Dig Site high Archaeology interface
methods.location: Sinkhole entrances; Daemonheim Dig Site (Archaeology)
methods.xp_rate: wiki: at 120 Dungeoneering and 99 Archaeology, using all boosts and converting tokens to XP, Dig Site method can exceed 100,000 Dungeoneering XP/h with no combat. Sinkholes are daily-gated XP/token supplements (gorajan outfit extra teleports and +10% sinkhole lamp XP on warped)
methods.notes: Ironman-friendly non-combat DG. Dragonkin VI collection (87 Archaeology) awards large token boxes. Pair with floor training for tokens spent on rewards.
